# Underwriting Memo

**Risk summary**

Everholt Inns operates select-service hotels near business districts in San Antonio, TX. The account consists of three non-coastal hotel locations with total insured value of $7,975,000. All properties are inland (202-212 km from coast). The governing class is HOTL (Hotel/Motel). The broker is Quillmark Commercial (Core) with a fit score of 65.6.

**Appetite and referral**

This submission requires referral per **AG-007**: Class HOTL requires senior underwriter approval. The account is within the $30M TIV maximum for hotel risks. Territory is acceptable under **AG-014** (Central inland locations in appetite subject to class rules). Request fire protection details, housekeeping standards, and additional loss information as specified in **AG-007**.

**Loss history**

Five-year history shows three claims totaling $157,700 incurred. 2023 had highest activity with two claims ($133,300 incurred; largest was theft). 2022 had one vehicle-into-storefront claim ($24,400). Years 2021, 2024, and 2025 were loss-free. No open claims currently.

**Exposure and concentration**

Portfolio concentration in San Antonio area is significant at $56,845,000 TIV within 25km of these locations. All three properties are non-coastal with favorable distance from windstorm exposure.

**Recommendation**

Suggest referring to senior underwriter with request for fire protection class, housekeeping protocols, and theft prevention measures given 2023 loss activity.
